# Aletheia Bodywork

> Aletheia Bodywork is a Rolfing® Structural Integration practice run by Luke Gregorczyk, a certified Rolfer® and member of the European Rolfing Association, based in Westoning, Bedfordshire, UK (five minutes from Harlington station, direct Thameslink trains from London St Pancras and Bedford).

The practice works with chronic back pain, neck, shoulder and jaw tension, and lasting posture change through slow, precise, hands-on bodywork — working with the pattern underneath the pain rather than just the symptom. Sessions are 60 minutes and cost £80.

The name Aletheia is an old Greek word for the moment something hidden comes to light.

## Key facts

- Practitioner: Luke Gregorczyk, Certified Rolfer®, European Rolfing Association member
- Service: Rolfing® Structural Integration (one-to-one, hands-on bodywork)
- Location: 5 Lovett Green, Westoning, Bedford MK45 4SP, United Kingdom
- Sessions: 60 minutes, £80
- Booking: hello@aletheiabodywork.co.uk
- Website: https://aletheiabodywork.co.uk
- Google reviews: 29 reviews, 5.0 average (profile: Aletheia Bodywork, Westoning)
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@AletheiaRolfing
